issues.on_page: Taxes: Other (Visitors Promotion 12,137 + Visitors Improvement 12,137, p14)
issues.issue: Lodging tax is inferred from the fund names. The page prints only 'Other' under Taxes. It is defensible and marked review.

The p5 schedule prints only 'Taxes'. The parenthetical was added by the extractor; the same applies to detail[1] 'Taxes (motor vehicle)' and detail[2] 'Taxes (other)'. The split amounts are correct (4,682,957 + 369,633 + 38,367 = 5,090,957, p4 General Fund column).
